name: a2a-mod
description: A2A for Claude Code: every session serves an A2A endpoint, so Claude sessions and A2A workers hand each other tasks and files. Registered workers and sessions show in ListAgents and take SendMessage as a2a:<alias>; /a2a scan finds them on a private network.

layout.title: A2A layout
layout.description: full: cards, band and workers pane. pane: the workers pane only. minimal: the status line only.

animations.title: A2A animations
animations.description: Off: spinners, shimmer, bars and the wire draw one still frame.

tokens.title: Worker tokens
tokens.description: alias=token pairs separated by spaces, e.g. "w1=abc w2=def"

server.title: A2A endpoint
server.description: On: this session serves an A2A endpoint (first free port in 41400-41499), so other Claude Code sessions and A2A agents can send it tasks. Off: no listening socket.

serverToken.title: A2A endpoint token
serverToken.description: Empty: open, anyone who can reach the port can message this session. Set: senders must send it as a Bearer token (they register this session with that token).

serverName.title: A2A endpoint name
serverName.description: The name on this session's Agent Card. Empty: <hostname>/<folder>.
